publishHint: Make this offering available for new public requests.
unpublishHint: Stop new public requests for this service. Existing requests and their agreed snapshots are preserved.
error: Unable to complete this action. Please check your information and try again.
unavailable: This service or agency is currently unavailable.
notConfirmed: This is a service request. Your preferred time is not a confirmed appointment.
notes: Brief operational notes (optional, no medical history)
privacy: I have read the privacy notice and agree to the use of this information to coordinate my request.
privacyText: We use the requester and beneficiary names, contact details, area and preferences to coordinate this request with this agency. Please do not enter medical history, diagnoses or full home addresses. Email messages contain a secure verification link. This acknowledgment is not consent to clinical treatment.
priceConsent: I acknowledge the displayed fixed price, currency, scope and price unit.
required: Please complete the required fields with valid information.
receipt: Keep this reference. It does not authorize access. Check your email for a secure verification link valid for 15 minutes.
linkSent: If the details match, a secure link will be emailed. Please check your inbox.
areasHint: Areas: one per line as code | Arabic name | English name
logo: Agency PNG logo (optional, RGB/RGBA, up to 512 × 512)
invalidLink: This link is unavailable, expired or already used. Request a new secure link.
